rca_of_the_issue.bug: INVALID_ID returns all 14 products instead of 0
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In marketplace_routes.py, when spotyou_id is provided but not found in DB, tags=[] is set. The condition `if tags:` is False, so it falls into `else:` which returns ALL products (SELECT ... LIMIT 20). The original code did not distinguish between 'no filter requested' (show all) and 'filter requested but yielded 0 tags' (show nothing).
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Added `filter_requested = bool(tag_ids or spotyou_id)` flag and `elif filter_requested: rows = []` branch. When a filter is specified but resolves to no tags, return empty list.
